verdict.rationale: Elicit does not document configurable background agent automations. Its closest native background behavior is Alerts, which watch for new relevant papers and send instant email notifications. Its API and MCP server let users script automated research reports and end-to-end systematic reviews from their own code, so autonomous runs require external orchestration. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered agent runs, background automations beyond paper alerts, and hands-on or independent corroboration of unattended operation.
